record.question: Which among the following banks was not penalised for non-compliance with various directions issued by the Reserve Bank of India?
record.explanation: Answer B: ICICI Bank. RBI’s 12 February 2019 release names HDFC Bank, IDBI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank as penalized. Of these four options, ICICI Bank was not among those three. Reference: https://www.rbi.org.in/commonman/Upload/English/PressRelease/PDFs/PR1914EN12022019.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
